svg.title: Two committees, two days apart, both on hold since September
svg.desc: Step chart since January 2025 of the Fed funds target upper limit and the ECB deposit rate. The Fed's upper limit falls from 4.50% to 3.75% between September and December 2025, then rises to 4.00% in September 2026. The ECB deposit rate falls from 3.00% to 2.00% by June 2025, rises to 2.25% in June 2026 and to 2.50% in September 2026. Both are unchanged since September; the latest values, for 26 October 2026, are 4.00% and 2.50%. The Fed meets on 27–28 October and the ECB decides on 29 October. Latest values: Fed funds, upper limit 4% (2026-10-26); ECB deposit rate 2.5% (2026-10-26).
svg.text: Two committees, two days apart, both on hold since September
Policy rates, %: Fed funds target range (upper limit) and ECB deposit facility rate, daily
SOURCE Federal Reserve Board (DFEDTARU) and European Central Bank (ECBDFR), both via FRED, St. Louis Fed
